C0650.title: Late-Night Private Message Sexual Harassment of Female Patients by a Celebrity Doctor
C0650.summary: In May 2021, dermatologist Lin Xiaoqing, who had 1.6 million followers on Weibo, was exposed by netizens for sexually harassing female patients through Weibo private messages, sending explicit personal questions. Lin later apologized, claiming the messages were sent by a Weibo assistant, but took responsibility as the account holder.

references.title: Prominent doctor exposed for 'late-night private message sexual harassment of female patient'! Here come the consequences... _ Tencent News
